name: "Roll 'n' Smash" Sugar Cookies with Sprinkles, Butterscotch Candy & Pecans (Cooking with Kids)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe uses Betty Crocker sugar cookie mix; if using different brands please adjust recipe ingredients and cooking times per package instructions.
This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Preheat oven to 375°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper. (Or work in batches if necessary.)
Cut butter into small pieces, place in a small bowl, and set aside to soften, 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, finely chop nuts and place on a plate.
Unwrap candies (if necessary) and place in a medium resealable plastic bag. Use a rolling pin or the bottom of a heavy pan to gently crush the candies into pieces. Place on another plate.
Place sprinkles on a third plate. Set all three plates aside.
When the butter is softened, place cookie mix and flour in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (496 g) pkg sugar cookie mix
3 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Add softened butter and egg to the bowl with the cookie mix. Stir until a dough comes together, about 2 minutes.
Working with a generous tablespoon at a time, roll dough into balls and place on another plate.

Roll dough balls in nuts, candies, or sprinkles as desired, then arrange on the baking sheets, spacing them 2-inches apart. Using your palm or the flat bottom of a measuring cup, gently press the cookies into ¼-inch thick discs.
Place baking sheets in the preheated oven and bake until golden around the edges, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, about 10 minutes. (The cookies will firm up as they cool.)
Arrange cookies on a platter and enjoy!
